sections.headline: Common Inquiries
sections.body: Clear answers regarding our processing times, solvent safety, and handling protocols.

items.question: Do you provide complimentary pickup and delivery?
items.answer: Yes, we offer complimentary delivery services within a 3-mile radius of our Market Street location for orders exceeding $50.

items.question: What type of cleaning solvents do you employ?
items.answer: We utilize advanced, environmentally conscious silicone-based solvents. They are 100% non-toxic, entirely odorless, and significantly less abrasive on delicate fibers than traditional perc.

items.question: Are you equipped to clean heavily embellished garments?
items.answer: Absolutely. Garments featuring intricate beadwork, sequins, or delicate lace undergo a highly controlled, specialized hand-cleaning protocol to prevent mechanical damage.

items.question: How long do structural tailoring projects usually take?
items.answer: Standard hems and minor adjustments require 48 hours. Complex tailoring requiring structural changes typically takes 5 to 7 business days following an initial fitting.
